method: Partial snapshot. 3,986 of 35,158 Streamable HTTP remote URLs listed in the official MCP Registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io, latest version per server, no template URLs) were checked on 2 Nov 2026 between 05:59 and 06:40 UTC; 3,780 answered and are counted. The first 940 checks ran in alphabetical registry order, the rest in random order, so the sample leans toward names starting with a. Each URL was checked once with McpStamp Check engine 1.0.0 or 1.1.0, with no credentials. A store counts as ready only when no blocking check failed and every blocking check could run; servers that need an API key are not counted ready for ChatGPT or Gemini. Checks added in engine 1.2.0 (Gemini metadata discovery order, ChatGPT issuer and token auth fields) were not applied, so ChatGPT and Gemini counts may be slightly high. Totals cover all 3,780 answering servers; the table shows a grade-balanced sample of 600. Run the live check for the current result.

totals.sampling: The first 940 results were taken in registry order (alphabetical by server name; almost all names under ac., ae., agency. and ai.); every later result follows a random shuffle (seed 1102) of all remaining URLs, with at most one check at a time per domain.
totals.store_rule: ready = no blocking check failed and none was left unverified (engine 1.1.0 rule); unverified = nothing failed but a blocking check could not run (for example tools behind sign-in)
